sections.lesson:
### Segment 6 — The Lesson
Rigid quantitative caps on a single input—here, weekly hours—invite substitution across other margins such as contract type, overtime rules, and work intensity. When those margins are easier to adjust than the capped variable, the original objective can be met only partially or not at all. Policymakers therefore benefit from modelling the full menu of responses available to the organisations they regulate rather than assuming the capped variable will move in isolation.
